Obtaining S-63 decryption credentials is an organisational process - application, signed agreement, IHO-issued credentials - not a download, and the IHO issues final OEM credentials only when an OEM is ready to launch. Consequence: even public-domain national ENC cells cannot be decrypted or displayed lawfully without this scheme relationship; owning the cells does not authorise a display system.
